name: Kaito Takahashi
source:
A well-liked stagehand at the Black Rose Revue, Kaito is known for his protective nature and dedication to the actresses. However, his superstitions and tales of spectral figures fuel rumors of a 'Phantom,' casting a shadow of unease and speculation throughout the Revue.
